about: Every value below is an ESTIMATE by the owner, not a reported number. 'basis' says what it is anchored on. Shared macro drivers (rates, inflation, GDP, CRR, minimum CAR) are read from sector/macro-assumptions/macro.csv by scenario name, not copied here.

anchor.fy2026e_method: Actual 9M-2026 plus Q4 estimate; 9M income tax retained, positive Q4 PBT taxed at 34%; 9M impairment retained; 673.482m actual dividend only; Q4 statutory transfer 12.5% of positive annual PAT, no YTD transfer reported.
anchor.same_for_all_scenarios: FY2026E is identical in all three scenarios because three quarters are already reported.

loan_yield_spread_over_tbill_364d_pct.basis: Calibrated so the formula roughly reproduces 9M-2026 annualised interest income (see checks.md calibration line). Sector average lending rate was 15.8% in Oct 2026 while the 364-day bill averaged about 11% in 2026.

liquid_yield_spread_over_tbill_91d_pct.basis: Same calibration. Liquid assets (due from banks plus investment securities) include foreign-currency placements, so the yield sits near the 91-day bill, not the 364-day.

cost_of_funds_to_policy_rate.basis: 9M-2026: interest expense annualised (109.3m) over average customer deposits (11,431m) is 0.96%. The policy rate averaged about 14.3% over Jan-Sep 2026 (15.5% in Jan-Feb, 14% from March), so the ratio is about 0.067.

tax_rate.basis: 9M-2026 total tax and levies / profit before tax = 35.7%. FY2024 29.8%, FY2023 restated 36.1%. Includes the Growth and Sustainability Levy; not split.

rates.fx_note: No current currency exposure or contractual repricing schedules; no standalone FX revaluation in forecast. Trading income scenario is a sensitivity.

growth.customer_deposit_growth_formula: (1+real GDP growth)*(1+CPI inflation)-1+adjustment, using the macro row of the same scenario and year

customer_deposit_adjustment.basis: Nominal GDP growth proxy; downside assumes deposit outflow or dollarisation, upside assumes share gains.

net_loan_growth.basis: Sector advances grew 36.7% y/y in Oct 2026 and SCB net loans rose 34.5% in 9M-2026 from a very low base (loans were 15% of deposits at FY2025). Growth fades as the base rebuilds.

net_trading_income_growth.basis: Net trading income swung from 141m (FY2023 restated) to 555m (FY2025) and 568m annualised in 2026, driven by foreign-exchange conditions. It is the least reliable line. Base assumes gradual mean reversion.

fee_income_growth_over_inflation.basis: Fee income was 294.6m in FY2025 and 208.7m in 9M-2026 (9M-2025: 243.7m, so down 14%). Base assumes recovery to inflation plus 2 points from FY2027E.

staff_cost_growth_over_inflation.basis: Staff costs grew 14.6% in FY2025 and 6.0% in 9M-2026 vs 9M-2025.

other_opex_growth_over_inflation.basis: Other operating expenses rose 48% in FY2025 (160m to 237m).

depreciation_growth.basis: Depreciation is small and mostly right-of-use.

other_operating_income.basis: Small and noisy (5m in FY2024, 27m in FY2025).

cost_of_risk_on_average_net_loans.basis: FY2025 and 9M-2026 show net reversals (impairment releases) that are unlikely to repeat. Reported gross NPL ratio is 23-26% but only 0.8% after the loss category, so the book is almost fully provided.

credit.note: No securities impairment is forecast after FY2026E. The 2022 domestic debt exchange cost the bank 602m on securities that year.

dividend_payout_of_prior_year_profit.basis: 2026 payment of 673.5m was 84% of FY2025 profit; FY2025 payment of 227.4m was 32% of FY2024; FY2024 payment of 399.9m was 49% of restated FY2023. Forecast target subject to positive distributable retained earnings after statutory transfer, 15% CAR proxy, nonnegative liquid assets and hypothetical 70% eligible cash proxy. FY26 no Q4 dividend.

statutory_reserve_transfer_of_profit.basis: Act 930 s34, official Q3 bank reserve fund864.660m > stated capital400m, unchanged from FY25; annual 12.5% positive PAT, zero YTD transfer, no actual regulatory compliance asserted.

operating_cash_to_customer_deposits.basis: 9M-2026 cash and balances at the Bank of Ghana 2,999m = 28.6% of customer deposits; less the 20% reserve requirement leaves 8.6%. The reserve is applied to ALL customer deposits (a simplification, since the rule applies to cedi deposits).

due_from_banks_share_of_liquid_assets.basis: 30 Sep 2026: due from banks 4,624m / (due from banks + investment securities 7,424m).

risk_weight_density_of_total_assets.basis: Implied at 30 Sep 2026: book equity / reported CAR (23.12%) / total assets. A crude proxy because regulatory capital differs from book equity.

capital_and_liquidity.eligible_cash_stress: 60% of projected cash versus 20% of all customer deposits; illustrative, no verified eligibility.
